title: ✨ Gemini 4 Neon Arrives in the Gemini App... Powerful Intelligence at Flash Speed!
body: ✨ Gemini 4 Neon Arrives in the Gemini App... Powerful Intelligence at Flash Speed!

On November 18, Google launched its new model, Gemini 4 Neon, an AI model that combines advanced reasoning power with fast performance, and it is now available in the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

Neon stands in the middle between Hydrogen, the fast model for everyday tasks, and Carbon, the larger model for long, difficult projects. It scored 61 points on the general intelligence index, ranking third among all models, ahead of bigger and slower rivals, and it also topped the coding agents index.

The model works with a context window of one million tokens, and offers four levels of reasoning that the user can choose from depending on how difficult and costly the task is. It costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, making it about a third cheaper per task than Carbon.

In the Gemini app, Neon appears under the 'Deeper analysis' option, replacing Argon and the old professional model. It is also available in the developer API, in Antigravity, where it can plan and direct Hydrogen agents in parallel, and in Gemini for Business.
Simply put: top-tier intelligence, but at the speed of lightweight models; so do you always choose the strongest model, or the model that gets your task done at the lowest cost?
